note.question: How do dynamic pricing and inventory control interact for substitutable products based on market conditions?
note.overview: This paper studies optimal integrated inventory and pricing decisions for substitutable products over a finite planning horizon with full backlogging and nonstationary costs and demands. The objective is to maximize the total expected discounted profit. We present a unified demand model that encompasses many commonly used models in the literature.
